method: 5 read-only reviewers (design, mobile, states, real user, launch) over the code, CI logs (core.yml 37290813859, app.yml 37290813769, uitests.yml 37290813942) and 83 simulator tour screenshots (one iPhone Pro size, dark + one light). No Mac or physical iPhone: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, small/large phones, iPad, Live Activity taps and kill/relaunch are code-only.

issues.title: The split takes the workout's shape on every edit, so a discarded or repeated workout still changes the split
issues.evidence: App/AppModel.swift:115 calls next.syncRoutine() in update(), for every change; Core/Sources/TrackCore/Workouts.swift:68 rewrites the split. Tour: Full body 15 sets (testTour-01) becomes 16 sets while the workout is still in progress (testTour-28). repeatWorkout (AppModel.swift:170) starts from the old session's done-only exercises, so Repeat cuts the split down at once. The website now syncs only on finish (Track/lib/store-actions.ts).
issues.reproduction_steps: Start a split, add a set or exercise, Workout options > Discard: the split keeps the change. Or History > workout > Repeat > Discard: the split loses exercises.
issues.user_impact: An abandoned or experimental workout permanently changes the routine; iOS and the website behave differently.
issues.proposed_fix: Drop syncRoutine() from update(); call it in Training.finish() before the session is stored, using the full active shape (as the website does).
issues.verification_plan: Core tests: start+add+discard leaves the split unchanged; start+add+finish updates it; repeat+discard leaves it unchanged. Tour testTour-28 shows 15 sets.

issues.title: After the saved file can't be read, nothing is ever saved again, a restored backup says 'Backup restored' but isn't kept, and Export gives an empty file
issues.evidence: AppModel.swift:100 canSave=false on a load error; :127 guard canSave drops every save silently. restore() (:153) goes through update() and never resets canSave, yet BackupSection shows 'Backup restored'. Export backup exports the empty in-memory copy. Only a Home line says the data 'was left untouched'.
issues.reproduction_steps: Make training.v1.json unreadable (e.g. sideload an older build after a newer one), launch, log a workout or restore a backup, kill, relaunch: all gone.
issues.user_impact: Silent data loss, and the one recovery path reports false success. Sideloading different builds makes this plausible.
issues.proposed_fix: restore(): move the unreadable file aside (training.v1.unreadable-<ms>.json), then canSave=true, loadError=nil before saving. While loadError is set, Data offers 'Export unreadable data' (the raw file) instead of an empty backup, and the Home notice says new changes won't be kept until a backup is restored.
issues.verification_plan: Unit test with a garbage file: restore(valid) persists and the unreadable copy exists; raw export URL is the file.

issues.title: Comma decimals ('62,5') are rejected in set weights and bodyweight
issues.evidence: Core/Sources/TrackCore/Sets.swift:72-74 only accepts a '.' decimal. The .decimalPad types ',' in comma regions. Editing a logged set to '62,5' clears its weight and un-logs it. The website now normalises ',' to '.'.
issues.reproduction_steps: Region Germany > workout > type 62,5. Or Rank > bodyweight 72,5.
issues.user_impact: Comma-decimal users can't log 2.5 kg plates; edits silently un-log sets.
issues.proposed_fix: In kilograms(from:), replace ',' with '.' after trimming.

issues.title: Deleting a set only works by swiping; VoiceOver can't do it
issues.evidence: SetRow.swift: the only way to arm delete is the HorizontalPan; no accessibilityAction or menu. Exercises do have one (Swipe.swift:105).
issues.reproduction_steps: VoiceOver on, focus a set, open Actions: no Delete.
issues.user_impact: VoiceOver/Switch Control users can't remove an extra set.
issues.proposed_fix: Add .accessibilityAction(named: "Delete set") { delete() } on the set's check button.
issues.verification_plan: UI test performs the custom action; row count drops and Undo shows.

issues.title: Toasts are cut to one line, so 'Couldn't save… Free up some space' and Finish's hint lose their instruction
issues.evidence: Overlays.swift:148 lineLimit(1). testFirstRun-11 shows a 45-char toast already filling the capsule; the save-failure (63 chars) and Finish hint (56) are longer.
issues.reproduction_steps: Tap Finish with no sets done.
issues.user_impact: The actionable part of the message is hidden.
issues.proposed_fix: lineLimit(3) with fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true).
issues.verification_plan: Tour screenshot of the Finish-with-0-sets toast shows the full text.

issues.title: A toast sits over the next set rows while the keyboard is up and blocks taps there
issues.evidence: Overlays.swift places the toast 92pt above the bottom safe area, which includes the keyboard; testTour-09 shows 'New best' over Bench Press set 3.
issues.reproduction_steps: Beat a best while typing in a workout.
issues.user_impact: Hides the very row the lifter types into next.
issues.proposed_fix: Ignore the keyboard safe area for the toast (stay above the tab bar / rest bar, under the keyboard's rows), so it never covers the fields.
issues.verification_plan: testTour-09: set rows 2-3 visible while the toast shows.

issues.title: History detail title and ✕ are jammed against the sheet's top edge, level with the grabber
issues.evidence: HistoryDetail.swift:86 pads horizontal and bottom only; testTour-45/46.
issues.reproduction_steps: History > open a workout.
issues.user_impact: Looks clipped; long names run under the grabber.
issues.proposed_fix: Add top padding (20) to the header.
issues.verification_plan: testTour-45/46: title clears the grabber, like Settings.

issues.title: Every set field has an amber tint from a gold shadow that is always drawn
issues.evidence: SetRow.swift:113 keeps the gold colour and only changes the radius to 0; testTour-04/11/21 fields look brown-amber vs the neutral dialog field (testTour-39).
issues.reproduction_steps: Start a workout in dark mode.
issues.user_impact: The main screen is tinted gold, which dilutes the 'new best' gold.
issues.proposed_fix: Make the shadow colour's opacity 0 unless glowing.
issues.verification_plan: testTour-04 fields neutral; glow still on a new best.

issues.title: Red text is too faint in dark mode (one fixed #E52626; the website uses #ff9eaa in dark)
issues.evidence: Theme.swift:14 danger used as text for Discard workout, Delete split, set errors, Settings, Home notice: 2.9-4.1:1. Website text red is light #c82f48 / dark #ff9eaa.
issues.reproduction_steps: Dark mode > Workout options.
issues.user_impact: Destructive labels and errors fall under 4.5:1.
issues.proposed_fix: Add Palette.dangerText (light 0xC82F48, dark 0xFF9EAA) for text; keep danger for fills.
issues.verification_plan: testTour-23/59 red text readable, matches website.

issues.title: Light-mode rank colours differ from the website and are hard to read (Elite 2.4:1, Solid 2.9:1)
issues.evidence: RankPage.swift:8-10 light values 6B7680/2A7FD6/14A35A/8A55EE/C99212; website ranks.css light 5f6a73/1f6fbf/16804a/7447c9/8a6a00.
issues.reproduction_steps: Light mode > Rank with a Solid or Elite muscle.
issues.user_impact: Rank names hard to read; mismatch with website.
issues.proposed_fix: Use the website's light values; keep the dark ones.

issues.title: The Welcome screen never says what Track is
issues.evidence: WelcomeView.swift:14-17 'Your training space / Welcome to Track / Choose where your workouts live.'; testFirstRun-01. The website says 'A simple gym tracker for your splits, sets and progress.'
issues.reproduction_steps: Fresh install.
issues.user_impact: Asked where to store data before being told what the app does.
issues.proposed_fix: Use the website's sentence under the title.

issues.title: About > Privacy opens the website's account policy, which doesn't fit the local-only iPhone app
issues.evidence: SettingsView.swift links trackk.pages.dev/privacy, which describes accounts, Supabase, cookies and deleting an account; the iOS app has no networking or account.
issues.reproduction_steps: Settings > About > Privacy.
issues.user_impact: Wrong data practices for iPhone users, and no word on how local data is deleted.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an 'iPhone app' section to the website's privacy page (data stays on the device; backups in Settings > Data; deleting the app deletes it) and link /privacy#iphone. Needs a website deploy to go live.
issues.verification_plan: Open the link; the iPhone section shows.

issues.title: Home doesn't refresh when the app comes back on a new day (date, 'Done today', week ring, streak)
issues.evidence: No scenePhase / significantTimeChange handling in App/. Home reads now only when its body runs.
issues.reproduction_steps: Finish at 21:00, leave Track in the background, open next morning: still 'Done today' and yesterday's date.
issues.user_impact: Undoes the calendar-day fix in the most common case.
issues.proposed_fix: AppModel.today (day key) refreshed on scenePhase .active and significantTimeChange; Home reads it.
issues.verification_plan: Simulator: background, change date, foreground: Home updates.

issues.title: iPad is turned on (all orientations, Split View) but never tested
issues.evidence: project.yml TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY "1,2"; uitests only boots an iPhone. Slide Over is ~320pt, narrower than an SE.
issues.reproduction_steps: Install on an iPad.
issues.user_impact: An untested layout.
issues.proposed_fix: iPhone only ("1") for now; iPads still run it in iPhone mode.

issues.title: Restore accepts any decodable file; bad values are saved and a negative bodyweight crashes Rank and Finish
issues.evidence: BackupSection.swift:42 checks decode + version only. Ranks.swift:134-138 indexes with a negative rank when bodyweight < 0. Website rejects out-of-range settings, duplicate ids and invalid done sets.
issues.reproduction_steps: Restore a backup with settings.bodyweight = -70 and a finished Bench set, open Rank.
issues.user_impact: A damaged file can crash the app on every Finish, persistently.
issues.proposed_fix: Training.validate() in Core (ranges, unique ids, done sets valid) used by import; and clamp rank to >= 0 in muscleRanks.
issues.verification_plan: Core tests: invalid fixtures rejected, website fixture passes, negative bodyweight doesn't trap.

issues.title: Workout options sheet is fixed at 360pt and would cut off Discard at large text
issues.evidence: WorkoutView.swift presentationDetents([.height(360)]), no ScrollView; content already ~315pt at default size (testTour-23).
issues.reproduction_steps: Larger Text AX3 > workout > options.
issues.user_impact: Rename/Discard unreachable for low-vision users.
issues.proposed_fix: ScrollView inside, detents [.height(360), .large].
issues.verification_plan: UI test at an accessibility text size: Discard hittable.

issues.title: Dialogs can't scroll, so on a small phone with the keyboard and large text the title or button can be pushed off
issues.evidence: Overlays.swift dialogCard has no ScrollView; fits at 402pt (testTour-55), not checked on an SE.
issues.reproduction_steps: iPhone SE, xxxLarge text, Create split.
issues.user_impact: Can't reach Close or the action while typing.
issues.proposed_fix: Wrap the card in ScrollView with scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize).

issues.title: Page titles and most Progress text use fixed sizes and ignore the system text size
issues.evidence: Components.swift:26-28 system(size: 16/32), SplitPage.swift:20 size 34, ProgressPage.swift 12-28pt fixed.
issues.reproduction_steps: Larger Text max > Home/Progress.
issues.user_impact: Headings and figures don't grow while body text does.
issues.proposed_fix: @ScaledMetric for the sizes (same defaults, so the default look doesn't change).
issues.verification_plan: Tour at an accessibility size: titles scale without clipping.

issues.title: Reordering exercises mid-workout is long-press drag only
issues.evidence: Reorder.swift onDrag; no Move up/down action.
issues.reproduction_steps: VoiceOver: try to move an exercise.
issues.user_impact: VoiceOver/Switch Control users can't reorder.
issues.proposed_fix: accessibilityAction 'Move up' / 'Move down' on the card header using the existing move.
issues.verification_plan: UI test performs the action; order changes.

issues.title: Small touch targets: round icon buttons ~40pt, clear (x) icons ~17-20pt, library rows tap only in a 32pt band, bodyweight pill ~31pt, D/W/M ~28pt, toast Undo ~20pt
issues.evidence: Components.swift GlassCircleButton 28pt frame; ExercisePicker.swift:239,263; HistoryView.swift:284,291; RankPage.swift:79; ProgressPage.swift:32; Overlays.swift:151. Measured in testTour-01/23/39/42/43/58.
issues.reproduction_steps: Measure in the listed screenshots.
issues.user_impact: Missed taps; the From clear sits 10pt from the date picker.
issues.proposed_fix: 44pt hit areas via frame + contentShape (visuals unchanged); library row minHeight 44.

issues.title: Number pads on Rank bodyweight and the custom rest field have no Done key
issues.evidence: RankPage.swift:93, SettingsView.swift:114; no keyboard toolbar, so onSubmit never runs. testFirstRun-07.
issues.reproduction_steps: Rank > Bodyweight field; Settings > Rest > Custom.
issues.user_impact: No obvious way to close the keyboard.
issues.proposed_fix: Keyboard toolbar Done, like WorkoutView's.

issues.title: Home's two tiles are different heights
issues.evidence: HomeCards.swift tiles set only maxWidth; testTour-01 and testFirstRun-03.
issues.reproduction_steps: Open Home.
issues.user_impact: Ragged grid.
issues.proposed_fix: maxHeight: .infinity on both tiles (Progress already does this).

issues.title: A personal-best set shows green numbers; the website shows gold
issues.evidence: SetRow.swift:109 ignores the record state; website rewards.css .is-record input uses --record. testTour-11.
issues.reproduction_steps: Beat a best.
issues.user_impact: Mixed gold/green row.
issues.proposed_fix: Gold value text when the row is a record.

issues.title: Workout set values show through behind the timer/subtitle when scrolled
issues.evidence: testTour-21; no scroll edge effect set.
issues.reproduction_steps: Scroll a workout.
issues.user_impact: Timer harder to read.
issues.proposed_fix: .scrollEdgeEffectStyle(.hard, for: .top) on the workout scroll view.

issues.title: Set weight error says kg in lb mode; bodyweight Save is disabled with no reason shown
issues.evidence: SetRow.swift:151 fixed 'kg'; RankPage.swift:99 disables Save silently (testFirstRun-06).
issues.reproduction_steps: lb mode > type 99999; Rank > bodyweight 10.
issues.user_impact: Wrong unit; unexplained disabled button.
issues.proposed_fix: Unit-aware message (website: 11,023 lb); show the range under the field when invalid.

issues.title: A number typed in the last 0.4s isn't saved if the app is backgrounded and killed at once
issues.evidence: SetRow.swift debounce; no scenePhase flush.
issues.reproduction_steps: Type, swipe up and kill immediately.
issues.user_impact: Rarely loses the last number.
issues.proposed_fix: flush() when scenePhase leaves .active.

issues.title: Tapping the rest Live Activity after a relaunch lands on Home, not the workout
issues.evidence: No widgetURL, onOpenURL or URL scheme; workoutOpen isn't restored.
issues.reproduction_steps: Rest running > kill Track > tap the Live Activity.
issues.user_impact: One extra tap mid-set.
issues.proposed_fix: widgetURL track://workout + scheme + onOpenURL opens the active workout.

issues.title: A cancelled workout edge swipe can leave the page half-pulled
issues.evidence: WorkoutView.swift pull is @State reset only in onEnded.
issues.reproduction_steps: Device: start the edge swipe, pull Notification Centre.
issues.user_impact: Shifted page until swiped again.
issues.proposed_fix: @GestureState for the live offset.

issues.title: The UI tour skips 5 steps silently (D/W/M never tapped; notification prompt covers first-run Done)
issues.evidence: uitests log 'TOUR missing: D/M/W' and 'keyboard Done'; segments are labelled Day/Week/Month (ProgressPage.swift:33).
issues.reproduction_steps: Read run 37290813942 log.
issues.user_impact: Progress period switch untested.
issues.proposed_fix: Tap Day/Week/Month; allow the prompt first; fail on any missing step.

issues.title: CI: a deprecation warning, a stray try, and Widgets-only changes don't rebuild the app
issues.evidence: CompletionView.swift:33 '+' on Text deprecated in iOS 26; WorkoutTests.swift:31 no throwing call; app.yml/uitests.yml paths omit Widgets/**.
issues.reproduction_steps: Read the CI logs.
issues.user_impact: A widget fix could ship in a stale IPA.
issues.proposed_fix: Text interpolation; drop try; add Widgets/** to both path filters.

issues.title: Welcome promises 'turn on sync later in Settings', but that row is disabled; the Sync card says 'Sign up or log in'
issues.evidence: WelcomeView.swift:23,26; SettingsView 'Turn on sync · Coming soon'.
issues.reproduction_steps: Fresh install.
issues.user_impact: A promise this build can't keep.
issues.proposed_fix: Short honest copy: sync is coming; nothing to sign into yet.

issues.title: Suggestion: denied notifications are never explained, and the rest alert asks for Time Sensitive without the entitlement
issues.evidence: RestAlert.swift returns silently when denied; interruptionLevel .timeSensitive with no entitlement in project.yml.
issues.reproduction_steps: Deny notifications, lock the phone during rest.
issues.user_impact: No alert with no hint why.
issues.proposed_fix: In Training settings, show 'Rest alerts are off' + Open Settings when denied. Leave the entitlement (free Apple ID may not allow it).

issues.title: Suggestion: VoiceOver gaps: dialogs aren't modal, muscle rows don't say open/closed, '+30s' has no spoken label
issues.evidence: Overlays.swift dialogCard has no .isModal; RankPage MuscleRow no accessibilityValue; RestCapsule '+30s'.
issues.reproduction_steps: VoiceOver through a dialog, Rank, the rest bar.
issues.user_impact: Confusing VoiceOver use.
issues.proposed_fix: .accessibilityAddTraits(.isModal) + escape action; accessibilityValue Open/Closed; label 'Add 30 seconds'.

issues.title: Suggestion: small token drift: streak colour, a duplicated red literal, History detail buttons bypass shared styles
issues.evidence: Theme.swift streak C2620E/F5A546 vs website c46a12/ffb76b; 0xBD1616 literal in SetRow and Swipe; HistoryDetail.swift:48,55 hand-built capsules.
issues.reproduction_steps: Compare with the website.
issues.user_impact: Slight mismatch.
issues.proposed_fix: Website streak values; one Palette.dangerDeep.

issues.title: Suggestion: the test seed code ships in the release build
issues.evidence: App/TestSeed.swift runs restore() when TRACK_SEED is set; no #if DEBUG. Users can't set the variable.
issues.reproduction_steps: n/a
issues.user_impact: None in practice.
issues.proposed_fix: Leave it (the UI tests need it; ponytail: not worth a build flag).
